leadText: Volume 12 is the twelfth volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the fifth of eight volumes in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.
plainText:
Volume 12 is the twelfth volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the fifth of eight volumes in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

==Blurb==
The three Legendary Pokémon Suicune, Raikou, and Entei are each searching for a worthy Trainer. Will they be able to find someone powerful enough to fight by their side?

Meanwhile, Crystal and Yellow have teamed up to find a mysterious flying Pokémon. Watch out for that vortex! That's right, the same one that Gold and Silver fell into...

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Chapter 143 - Irked Igglybuff and Curmudgeonly Cleffa
Chapter 144 - Savvy Swinub
Chapter 145 - Sandslash Surprise
Chapter 146 - Lively Lugia (Part 1)
Chapter 147 - Lively Lugia (Part 2)
Chapter 148 - Lively Lugia (Part 3)
Chapter 149 - Curious Kingdra
Chapter 150 - Chinchou in Charge
Chapter 151 - Lovely Lanturn
Chapter 152 - Buzz Off, Butterfree!
Chapter 153 - Oh, It's Ho-Oh!
Chapter 154 - Yikes, It's Yanma!

==Important events==
 
Whitney, DJ Mary, and the Radio Director visit Pryce's Gym, where they battle a statue and soon leave upon realizing that it was made of mobile ice. In the aftermath, Pryce puts on an evil smirk and mutters that Suicune won't come to visit him for a good reason.
meets up with and in the Whirl Islands, who were earlier joined by Lt. Surge.
The three Johto Pokédex holders almost succeed in capturing the that attacked them.
They try to track the Pokémon down, but all three of their Pokédexes fail in doing so, indicating that someone managed to catch it first.
Suicune joins Misty's team in the Tohjo Falls.
The opening ceremonies of the 10th Pokémon League commences, with all 16 Gym Leaders participating in a tournament. Gold and Crystal are called upon to attend this event secretly.

Silver's Croconaw evolves into a in PS148.
Crystal's "Megaree" evolves into in PS148.

==Character summary==
This is Crystal's Pokédex information and party at the end of this volume.
===Crystal's Pokédex===
Pokémon seen: 164
Pokémon owned: 152

==Trivia==
===Localization changes===
The message by Hidenori Kusaka is different between languages. In the Japanese version, he talks about the announcement of Pokémon games for the Game Boy Advance. In the English version, there is a short summary of the events of this volume instead.
